Le prototype simule 4,90 € sous 100 € d’: The prototype simulates €4.90 delivery below €100 and free delivery from €100. Delivery times and areas are yet to be defined.

Les cookies de session et de protection: Session and CSRF protection cookies will be documented when the APIs are connected. Optional trackers will require appropriate management before activation; no pretend consent panel is provided here.
Les coordonnées de l’hébergeur de produc: Production hosting details and the operator’s contact information must be published once confirmed. No fictional phone number, address or company identifier is presented as real.
Les coordonnées réelles du service clien: Actual customer service contact details have not been defined yet. No response time is promised.
Les demandes de retour nécessiteront une: Return requests will require an eligible real order and server authorisation. No refund is triggered.

Les montants et stocks seront vérifiés c: Amounts and stock will be checked on the server before any real payment. Your cart stays intact at the end of this preview.
Les pays et zones desservis, transporteu: Delivery countries and areas, carriers, times, restrictions and lost-parcel procedures are yet to be defined. No real shipping takes place.
Les photographies sont chargées depuis U: Photographs are loaded from Unsplash, which sends requests to that service. Hosting and any technical logs must be documented for the chosen deployment.
Les photos illustratives proviennent d’U: Illustrative photos come from Unsplash. Content usage rights and required permissions must be checked before commercial publication.
Les simulations ne donnent lieu à aucun: Previews do not result in any purchase, return or refund. Account pages only illustrate the intended flow.
